title: Universal Orlando Parks with Kids: Which of the 4 to Pick (2026)

Holiday tips for families: parade and show times are in the Universal app, so check them the morning you go. Universal also notes that ticket prices and availability vary by day, so compare dates before you lock in a holiday week. If your trip lands between December 11 and 16, remember that Monsters Unchained and Jurassic Park River Adventure are both closed for part of that week.
Tickets: One Park per Day or Park-to-Park?
Universal's ticket FAQ (checked November 23, 2026) describes two main types:
one park each day, including Epic Universe, Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure or Volcano Bay.

move between parks on the same day. Universal says Park-to-Park is available at every Universal Orlando theme park, including Epic Universe. With Park-to-Park access to Islands of Adventure and Universal Studios Florida, you can also ride the Hogwarts Express between Hogsmeade and Diagon Alley. Universal's height page doesn't list a minimum height for the train, which makes it a great little-kid "ride."

What are the 4 parks at Universal Orlando?

Universal Studios Florida, Universal Islands of Adventure and Universal Epic Universe are the three theme parks. Universal Volcano Bay is the water park, and it is closed for maintenance until a planned reopening on or before April 1, 2027 (checked November 23, 2026).
How many parks are in Universal Orlando?
Four: three theme parks and one water park. Universal CityWalk is a dining and entertainment district, not a park.
What parks are at Universal Studios?
If you mean the Orlando resort, the parks are Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure, Epic Universe and Volcano Bay. Universal Studios Florida is the name of just one of them.
Which Universal Orlando park is best for young kids?

Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure have the most rides with no minimum height. For a child who is 36 to 39 inches tall, Islands of Adventure has the most options. Once a child reaches 40 inches, Epic Universe opens up.
Is Epic Universe good for little kids?
Yes, though it is better once a child reaches 40 inches. Constellation Carousel and Fyre Drill have no height requirement, and Yoshi's Adventure starts at 34 inches.
What can a child under 40 inches ride at Universal?

No-minimum rides like Caro-Seuss-el, One Fish, Two Fish, Red Fish, Blue Fish, Kang & Kodos' Twirl 'n' Hurl, Villain-Con Minion Blast, Constellation Carousel and Fyre Drill. Then add E.T. Adventure and Yoshi's Adventure at 34 inches and the 36-inch rides above. See the
Is Volcano Bay open in December 2026?
No. Universal's park hours page (checked November 23, 2026) says it is closed for maintenance until a planned reopening on or before April 1, 2027.
Are the Universal holiday events included with a ticket?

Yes. Universal's holidays page says Holidays at Universal Orlando (November 14, 2026 to January 3, 2027) is included with a theme park ticket or pass, with blockout dates and restrictions for passes. The Grinch & Friends Character Breakfast and Universal Holiday Tour cost extra.
What is Child Swap at Universal?
One adult waits with a child who can't or won't ride, then trades places when the rest of the group is off the ride. Ask a ride attendant for details.
